All three inputs are currently available, so no current runtime failure is observed.

However, files.len() is not compared to successfully read documents; unreadable files silently contribute zero, and extra untracked documents augment whole-population floors/reporting. The ratchet itself is explicitly designed around tracked files and avoids tying behavior to licensed files.
candidates.disposition: Parent executed the supplemental census: 1020 documents, tracked-974 ratchet passed. No unreadable input was reported in that execution summary. The test body still does not explicitly compare listed files to successfully examined documents; this is a test-accounting limitation, not an observed product defect.
